Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the search results and conflated Lion Air (Indonesian airline) with Thai Lion Air, incorrectly asserting Don Mueang (Bangkok, Thailand) as the primary hub. This led to selecting Thailand’s former name (Siam) instead of Indonesia’s former name (Dutch East Indies). The WebSurfer’s results actually pointed to Indonesian airports (e.g., Soekarno–Hatta, Juanda), but the Planner prematurely concluded and marked the task complete without verification.
